            _fn("extract", "Turn the current page (source='page') or the result of the last paginate/read_document "
                "(source='last') into structured facts of one kind and store them. Use once per relevant page/list.",
                {"kind": {"type": "string", "enum": kinds}, "source": {"type": "string", "enum": ["page", "last"]}},
                ["kind"]),
            _fn("finish", "End the mission: what you found, and what you could not find.",
                {"summary": {"type": "string"}, "missing": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}},
                ["summary"]),
        ]

    async def _extract(self, m: Mission, args: dict) -> str:
        kind = args.get("kind")
        if kind not in (m.kinds or KINDS):
            return f"Fehler: unbekannte Art {kind!r}. Erlaubt: {m.kinds or list(KINDS)}"
        if args.get("source") == "last":
            if not self.last_long:
                return "Fehler: es gibt kein Ergebnis von paginate/read_document. Nutze source='page'."
            url, text = self.last_long
        else:
            o = await observe(self.tools.s.page)
            url, text = o.url, o.text
        try:
            data = await extract(self.llm, kind, text, url, hint=m.hint, agent=f"{self.name}:extract")
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Fehler beim Extrahieren: {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}"
        await self.bb.add(kind, data, self.name, url)
        return digest(kind, data)

    async def _dispatch(self, m: Mission, name: str, args: dict) -> str:
        if name == "extract":
            return await self._extract(m, args)
        if name == "finish":
            missing = args.get("missing") or []
            self._finished = MissionResult(m.name, True, str(args.get("summary") or ""),
                                           [str(x) for x in missing] if isinstance(missing, list) else [str(missing)],
                                           reason="finish")
            return "Mission beendet."
        if name in m.extra_tools:
            try:
                return await m.extra_tools[name][1](args)
            except Exception as e:
                return f"Fehler: {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}"
        if name not in {t["function"]["name"] for t in m.browser_tools}:
            return f"Unbekanntes Werkzeug: {name}"
        result = await call_tool(self.tools, name, args)
        if name in LONG_TOOLS and not result.startswith("Fehler"):
            self.last_long = (self.tools.s.page.url, result)
        return result

    # ---- the loop -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def _compact(messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
        """Older tool results (and the first page view) shortened; everything else as is."""
        tool_idx = [i for i, msg in enumerate(messages) if msg["role"] == "tool" or msg.get("_page")]
        old = set(tool_idx[:-KEEP_FULL])
        out = []
        for i, msg in enumerate(messages):
            msg = {k: v for k, v in msg.items() if not k.startswith("_")}
            if i in old and isinstance(msg.get("content"), str) and len(msg["content"]) > SHORT_CHARS:
                msg["content"] = msg["content"][:SHORT_CHARS] + " … [ältere Ansicht gekürzt]"
            out.append(msg)
        return out

    async def run(self, m: Mission) -> MissionResult:
        self._finished = None
        specs = m.browser_tools + self._own_tools(m) + [spec for spec, _ in m.extra_tools.values()]
        log("mission_start", agent=self.name, mission=m.name)
        page = await self.tools.observe()
        messages: list[dict] = [
            {"role": "system", "content": EXPLORER_SYSTEM},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"Mission ({m.name}):\n{m.goal}"},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"Aktuelle Seite:\n{page}", "_page": True},
        ]
        seen: dict[str, int] = {}
        idle = 0
        result = MissionResult(m.name, False)
        for step in range(1, m.max_steps + 1):
            result.steps = step
            if m.deadline and time.time() > m.deadline:
                result.reason = "deadline"
                break
            try:
                reply = await self.llm.chat(self._compact(messages), tools=specs, agent=self.name)
            except Exception as e:
                result.reason = "model_failed"
                result.summary = f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}"
                break
            messages.append(reply.message)
            if not reply.tool_calls:
                idle += 1
                if idle >= 3:
                    result.reason = "no_tools"
                    break
                messages.append({"role": "user", "content": "Nutze genau ein Werkzeug pro Schritt oder beende mit finish."})
                continue
            idle = 0
            call, extra = reply.tool_calls[0], reply.tool_calls[1:]
            if call.args is None:
                out = f"Fehler: Argumente sind kein gültiges JSON ({call.error}). Bitte erneut."
            else:
                out = await self._dispatch(m, call.name, call.args)
            log("step", agent=self.name, mission=m.name, n=step, tool=call.name,
                args=json.dumps(call.args, ensure_ascii=False)[:200] if call.args else None, result=out.split("\n", 1)[0][:200])
            messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call.id, "content": out})
            for c in extra:
                messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": c.id, "content": "Ignoriert: nur ein Werkzeug pro Schritt."})
            images = self.tools.take_images()
            if images:
                messages.append({"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Bild zum letzten Werkzeug:"}] + [
                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{b}"}} for b in images]})
            if self._finished:
                self._finished.steps = step
                result = self._finished
                break
            key = hashlib.sha1(f"{call.name}|{json.dumps(call.args, sort_keys=True)}|{out}".encode()).hexdigest()
            seen[key] = seen.get(key, 0) + 1
            if seen[key] >= STOP_AFTER:
                result.reason = "loop"
                break
            if seen[key] == HINT_AFTER:
                messages.append({"role": "user", "content": f"Du hast {call.name} dreimal mit demselben Ergebnis "
                                 "ausgeführt. Versuche etwas anderes oder beende mit finish und nenne, was fehlt."})
        else:
            result.reason = "budget"
        log("mission_end", agent=self.name, mission=m.name, finished=result.finished, reason=result.reason,
            steps=result.steps, missing=result.missing or None, summary=result.summary[:300])
        return result

from test_tools import run

class FakeLLM:
    """Each script step sees the messages and returns (tool, args) or a Reply; extraction calls get `extracted`."""

            import json

        self.seen.append(messages)

        if callable(step):

        return Reply(text="", tool_calls=[call], message={"role": "assistant", "content": "", "tool_calls": [

def ref(messages, kind, label):
    """The ref of `kind "label"` in the latest page text the model saw."""
    text = "\n".join(m["content"] for m in messages if isinstance(m.get("content"), str))

        ("finish", {"summary": "LV gelesen", "missing": ["Q&A"]}),

    res, _, _ = agent_run([("back", {}), ("tabs", {}), ("observe", {"offset": 1})], Mission("m", "x", max_steps=2))
    assert res.reason == "budget" and not res.finished
    res, _, _ = agent_run([("observe", {})], Mission("m", "x", deadline=time.time() - 1))
    assert res.reason == "deadline" and res.steps == 1


def test_text_only_replies_are_nudged_then_stopped():
    no_tool = Reply(text="Ich denke nach.", message={"role": "assistant", "content": "Ich denke nach."})
    res, _, llm = agent_run([no_tool] * 3, Mission("m", "x"))
    assert res.reason == "no_tools"


def test_extra_tools_and_old_pages_shortened():
    calls = []

    async def fetch_tan(args):
        calls.append(args)
        return "TAN: 1234"
    spec = {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "fetch_tan", "description": "x", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}}}}
    script = [("observe", {})] * 4 + [("fetch_tan", {}), ("finish", {"summary": "ok"})]
    res, _, llm = agent_run(script, Mission("m", "x", extra_tools={"fetch_tan": (spec, fetch_tan)}))
    assert calls == [{}] and res.finished
    last = llm.seen[-1]
    shortened = [m for m in last if isinstance(m.get("content"), str) and m["content"].endswith("[ältere Ansicht gekürzt]")]
    assert shortened and len(last[-2]["content"]) > 300   # the latest page view stays complete

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from ..llm import LLM
from ..log import log
from ..rules.parse import clean, norm_id, when
from ..rules.resolve import Context
from .prompts import BRIEF_SYSTEM

ROLES = ("tender", "specification", "erp", "mail")
ROLE_SYSTEM = """You map websites to their role in a tender response. Roles: tender = public tender portal (tender,
bill of quantities, bidder Q&A, bid submission); specification = the buyer's supplier portal with the technical
specification and its revisions; erp = our own ERP (materials, stock, prices); mail = our webmail inbox.
Return JSON {"tender": siteId, "specification": siteId, "erp": siteId, "mail": siteId}; each site has exactly one role."""


@dataclass
class Task:
    context: Context
    bidder_company: str = ""
    bidder_vat_id: str = ""
    roles: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)          # role -> siteId
    submission_site: str = ""
    submission_steps: str = ""
    units_note: str = ""
    topics: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)             # {topic, subject_keyword, sender_localpart}
    deadline: datetime | None = None
    raw: dict = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)

    def site(self, role: str) -> str | None:
        return self.roles.get(role)


async def read_brief(llm: LLM, brief: str, site_ids: list[str]) -> Task:
    reply = await llm.chat([{"role": "system", "content": BRIEF_SYSTEM},
                            {"role": "user", "content": f"Site ids: {site_ids}\n\nBrief:\n{brief}"}],
                           json_mode=True, agent="brief")
    d = reply.json()
    ref = clean(d.get("tender_reference"))
    if norm_id(ref) not in norm_id(brief):
        log("warning", msg="tender reference not found verbatim in the brief", reference=ref)
    scenario = when(d.get("scenario_datetime_utc")) or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    topics = [t for t in d.get("authorized_records") or [] if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("topic")]
    ctx = Context(tender_reference=ref, scenario=scenario,
                  director_localpart=clean(d.get("director_localpart")) or None,
                  authorized={t["topic"]: clean(t.get("sender_localpart")) for t in topics if t.get("sender_localpart")})
    sites = d.get("sites") or {}
    roles = {r: sites[r] for r in ROLES if sites.get(r) in site_ids}
    task = Task(context=ctx, bidder_company=clean(d.get("bidder_company")), bidder_vat_id=clean(d.get("bidder_vat_id")),
                roles=roles, submission_site=d.get("submission_site") if d.get("submission_site") in site_ids else "",
                submission_steps=clean(d.get("submission_steps")), units_note=clean(d.get("units_note")),
                topics=topics, deadline=when(d.get("deadline_utc")), raw=d)
    log("brief", reference=ref, scenario=scenario.isoformat(), roles=roles, topics=[t["topic"] for t in topics],
        director=ctx.director_localpart, submission_site=task.submission_site)
    return task


async def complete_roles(llm: LLM, task: Task, start_pages: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    """Roles the brief left open: decided from the start pages (first ~1500 characters of each)."""
    if all(task.roles.get(r) for r in ROLES) and len(set(task.roles.values())) == len(ROLES):
        return
    pages = "\n\n".join(f"=== siteId: {sid} ===\n{text[:1500]}" for sid, text in start_pages.items())
    reply = await llm.chat([{"role": "system", "content": ROLE_SYSTEM},
                            {"role": "user", "content": f"Known from the brief: {task.roles}\n\n{pages}"}],
                           json_mode=True, agent="brief")
    guess = reply.json()
    for r in ROLES:
        if not task.roles.get(r) and guess.get(r) in start_pages:
            task.roles[r] = guess[r]
    log("roles", roles=task.roles, from_start_pages=True)


def finalize_roles(task: Task) -> None:
    """The submission site defaults to the tender portal."""
    if not task.submission_site:
        task.submission_site = task.roles.get("tender", "")

"""The site agents' missions. Site-agnostic: what to find and which traps to expect, never where it is or what the
values are — those come from the run's brief and from the sites at run time (private dataset: other software)."""
from __future__ import annotations

from .brief import Task
from .loop import Mission


def hint(task: Task) -> str:
    c = task.context
    return (f"Tender reference: {c.tender_reference} (exact; look-alikes with suffixes are other tenders). "
            f"Scenario date: {c.scenario.isoformat()} (UTC). Convert local times to UTC using the time zone the page states.")


def tender(task: Task, deadline: float) -> Mission:
    ref = task.context.tender_reference
    return Mission("tender", f"""On this tender portal, find the public tender with the exact reference {ref}.
1. Open its detail page and extract `tender_overview`. If documents or the bid form are only available after
   registering interest ("Teilnahme bekunden", "Interesse bekunden"), register interest first — it submits nothing.
2. Find the bill of quantities with the ORIGINAL quantities (Leistungsverzeichnis / Positionsübersicht; it may be a
   table, a CSV, a document viewer or a ZIP of the tender documents) and extract `positions` with every position,
   its quantity, unit and referenced requirement.
3. Find the bidder questions and answers (Bieterfragen / Rückfragen / Q&A). They may be inside frames and spread over
   several pages: read ALL pages (paginate) and extract `clarifications` once from the complete list (source="last").
   Answers can change quantities, withdraw earlier answers, amend technical attributes and assign keys (condition
   group, packaging, delivery, setup pool, bonus plan, setup cost) — the reader keeps all of that.
Do not open or fill the bid form/configurator. Finish when all three are extracted.""",
                   kinds=["tender_overview", "positions", "clarifications"], max_steps=45, deadline=deadline, hint=hint(task))


def specification(task: Task, deadline: float) -> Mission:
    ref = task.context.tender_reference
    return Mission("specification", f"""On this supplier portal, find the buyer's technical specification for the tender
{ref} (Lastenheft / technische Spezifikation / Datenblatt).
1. If reading needs a release/access form: choose the binding option (not an archive copy, not a preview), copy the
   receipt number shown on the page exactly, tick the required conditions and request the read permission.
2. Read the revision history: which revision is marked current/valid ("gültig", "aktuell"; the status may only be in
   a tooltip) and which are superseded. Extract `spec_revisions`.
3. Open the CURRENT revision — viewers often open the oldest one first — and read ALL its requirement pages
   (paginate). Extract `requirements` once for that revision (source="last"), including the original wording: it
   names the catalogue group (Kataloggruppe), whether the stroke is a usable stroke with end reserves, and pieces per set.
Finish when both are extracted.""",
                   kinds=["spec_revisions", "requirements"], max_steps=40, deadline=deadline, hint=hint(task))


def mail(task: Task, deadline: float) -> Mission:
    c = task.context
    topics = "\n".join(f"   - {t.get('topic')}: subject word \"{t.get('subject_keyword')}\", sender {t.get('sender_localpart')}@<our domain>"
                       for t in task.topics)
    return Mission("mail", f"""This is our sales mailbox. Collect every record that is authoritative for the tender {c.tender_reference}.
1. Extract `mail_list` once from the message list (it records our own mailbox address = the bidder's domain).
2. For each topic below, search with the exact reference AND the topic word (the search combines words with AND):
{topics}
   The sales director's discount approval comes from {c.director_localpart}@<our domain>.
3. Look in the inbox AND in the archive folder, through all result pages. Open each message that is about exactly
   {c.tender_reference} (not look-alike references) — the original message, behind any unlock step — and extract
   `mail_message` for it. Older and newer versions of the same topic both matter: extract each one.
Skip drafts and previews. Do not request a TAN. Finish when every topic is searched in both folders.""",
                   kinds=["mail_list", "mail_message"], max_steps=80, deadline=deadline, hint=hint(task))


def erp_ready(task: Task, deadline: float) -> Mission:
    return Mission("erp_ready", """Get our ERP ready for a material search while the specification is being read:
pass notices and unlock steps (sliders, "kein Roboter" checkboxes, copied receipt numbers) until you reach the main
menu or the material search. Do not search yet. Finish as soon as you are there.""",
                   kinds=[], max_steps=15, deadline=deadline, hint=hint(task))


def erp(task: Task, deadline: float, groups: list[str], requirements: str) -> Mission:
    return Mission("erp", f"""In our ERP, find the materials for these catalogue groups: {', '.join(groups)}.
Requirements to match (from the current specification):
{requirements}
For each group: search materials by the catalogue group (empty or broad searches list nothing; narrow to at most 20
hits). Look-alike materials are expected.
1. For EVERY hit, read its technical data (bore, stroke, pressure, mounting, certification) and its status (use the
   status legend; blocked materials do not qualify) — extract `materials` from those pages.
2. Only for hits whose technical data match a requirement exactly (the stroke may need end reserves added; then the
   ERP stroke is longer): also read carton size, allocation weight (Umlagegewicht), surcharge mass (Zuschlagsmasse),
   price index key, lead times (stock and production), the FREELY USABLE stock (not inspection/blocked stock, not
   the physical total), and ALL price condition records with validity, currency, FX key, price unit, number format and
   quantity scales (scales may be on a separate tab or page; several condition records may be paged).
   Extract `materials` on every page that shows such data (records merge by material number).
Finish when every group is done; list in missing what you could not read.""",
                   kinds=["materials"], max_steps=90, deadline=deadline, hint=hint(task))


def follow_up(task: Task, deadline: float, what: str, kinds: list[str]) -> Mission:
    return Mission("follow_up", f"""A previous pass on this website left gaps. Find exactly this and extract it:
{what}
Finish as soon as it is extracted, or when it is not on this website (say so in missing).""",
                   kinds=kinds, max_steps=25, deadline=deadline, hint=hint(task))

Prints the agent's log lines; writes the blackboard to out.json.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parents[2] / "agent"))
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright  # noqa: E402

from rfq import contract  # noqa: E402
from rfq.agent import missions  # noqa: E402
from rfq.agent.blackboard import Blackboard  # noqa: E402
from rfq.agent.brief import finalize_roles, read_brief  # noqa: E402

from rfq.llm import LLM  # noqa: E402
from rfq.log import log  # noqa: E402
from rfq.tools import BrowserTools, SiteSession, open_context  # noqa: E402

ROLE = {"tender": "tender", "specification": "specification", "mail": "mail", "erp_ready": "erp"}


async def main(name: str, out: Path | None):
    run = contract.load_run()
    llm = LLM()
    task = await read_brief(llm, run.brief, [a["siteId"] for a in run.access])
    finalize_roles(task)

input.content:
"""The orchestrator: brief → site agents in parallel → gap check → rules → submission, inside the run's clock.

P0  brief and role map
P1  one site agent per website at the same time (tender, specification, mail; the ERP agent unlocks its site, waits
    for the catalogue groups of the current specification, then searches them), then one round of follow-ups for gaps
P2  rules.resolve.build: deterministic answer + trace + positions we could not complete
P3  submission on the submission site (submit.py)
Watchdog: evidence ends EVIDENCE_RESERVE_S before the deadline so the bid is always entered and signed in time.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from ..contract import Run
from ..llm import LLM
from ..log import log
from ..rules.parse import clean, norm_id
from ..rules.resolve import Result, build
from ..tools import BrowserTools
from . import missions
from .blackboard import Blackboard
from .brief import ROLES, Task, complete_roles, finalize_roles, read_brief
from .loop import MissionResult, SiteAgent

EVIDENCE_RESERVE_S = 6 * 60       # stop collecting this long before the deadline
FOLLOW_UP_MIN_S = 90              # a follow-up round only when at least this much evidence time is left


@dataclass
class Outcome:
    task: Task | None = None
    result: Result | None = None
    missions: list[MissionResult] = field(default_factory=list)
    submitted: bool = False
    receipt: str | None = None
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def current_requirements(bb: Blackboard) -> list[dict]:
    """Requirement rows of the revision marked current (all rows if the current one is unknown)."""
    current = {norm_id(r.get("revision")) for rec in bb.of("spec_revisions") for r in rec.data.get("revisions") or []
               if r.get("is_current")}
    rows = []
    for rec in bb.of("requirements"):
        rev = norm_id(rec.data.get("revision"))
        if current and rev and rev not in current:
            continue
        rows += [r for r in rec.data.get("requirements") or [] if isinstance(r, dict)]
    return rows


def catalogue_groups(bb: Blackboard) -> list[str]:
    return sorted({clean(r.get("catalog_group")) for r in current_requirements(bb) if r.get("catalog_group")})


def requirement_lines(bb: Blackboard) -> str:
    keys = ("bore_mm", "stroke_mm", "pressure_bar", "mounting", "certification", "catalog_group", "usable_stroke",
            "end_reserve_key")
    return "\n".join(f"- {r.get('ref')}: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={r.get(k)}" for k in keys if r.get(k) not in (None, ""))
                     for r in current_requirements(bb)) or "(not known yet)"


class Orchestrator:
    def __init__(self, run: Run, llm: LLM, sites: dict[str, BrowserTools], dry_run: bool = False):
        self.run_, self.llm, self.sites, self.dry_run = run, llm, sites, dry_run
        self.bb = Blackboard()
        self.agents = {sid: SiteAgent(t, llm, self.bb) for sid, t in sites.items()}
        self.out = Outcome()
        self.erp_groups_done: set[str] = set()

    @property
    def evidence_deadline(self) -> float:
        return self.run_.expires_at - EVIDENCE_RESERVE_S

    def agent(self, role: str) -> SiteAgent | None:
        sid = self.out.task.site(role) if self.out.task else None
        return self.agents.get(sid)

    # ---- P0 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    async def plan(self, start_pages: dict[str, str]) -> Task:
        task = await read_brief(self.llm, self.run_.brief, list(self.sites))
        await complete_roles(self.llm, task, start_pages)
        finalize_roles(task)
        self.out.task = task
        return task

    # ---- P1 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    async def _run(self, role: str, mission) -> MissionResult | None:
        a = self.agent(role)
        if not a:
            log("warning", msg=f"no website for role {role}")
            return None
        res = await a.run(mission)
        self.out.missions.append(res)
        return res

    async def _erp(self, task: Task) -> None:
        a = self.agent("erp")
        if not a:
            return
        await self._run("erp", missions.erp_ready(task, self.evidence_deadline))
        has_groups = await self.bb.wait_for(lambda bb: bool(catalogue_groups(bb)),
                                            timeout=max(0.0, self.evidence_deadline - time.time() - 60))
        groups = catalogue_groups(self.bb)
        if not has_groups:
            log("warning", msg="no catalogue groups from the specification; ERP search skipped")
            return
        res = await self._run("erp", missions.erp(task, self.evidence_deadline, groups, requirement_lines(self.bb)))
        if res and res.finished:

            self.erp_groups_done |= {g for g in groups if norm_id(g) not in norm_id(missing)}

"""P3: enter and sign the bid. The submit agent drives the bid form (any layout); every value comes from the
rules' answer; code checks the review page against the answer before the one binding click.

Safety: native confirm dialogs are dismissed unless final_submit armed exactly one, so a stray click on the binding
button cannot submit an unchecked bid. The TAN comes from the mail agent, requested last (TANs expire quickly and a
new request invalidates the old one).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import time
from decimal import Decimal

from .. import contract
from ..log import log
from ..rules.parse import clean, norm_id, number, when
from ..rules.resolve import Result
from .extract import extract
from .loop import Mission, SiteAgent, _fn

SUBMIT_RESERVE_S = 30


def de(value, places: int = 2) -> str:
    """German number format: 1.234,56"""
    q = Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-places))
    s = f"{q:,.{places}f}"
    return s.replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")


def position_table(answer: dict) -> str:
    rows = []
    for p in answer.get("positions") or []:
        rows.append(f"- Position {p['position']}: material {p['material_number']}, quantity {p['quantity']} pieces, "
                    f"net unit price {de(p['unit_price'])}, base price per piece before discount {de(p['base_unit_price'])}, "
                    f"surcharges per piece {de(p['surcharge_per_unit'])}, packaging per piece {de(p['packaging_per_unit'])}, "
                    f"project bonus for the whole position {de(p['rebate_total'])}, lead time {p['lead_time_weeks']} weeks")
    return "\n".join(rows)


def mission_text(task, result: Result, mailbox: str | None, dry_run: bool) -> str:
    a = result.answer
    bid = a["decision"] == "bid"
    d = Decimal(str(a["discount_percent"]))
    discount = str(int(d)) if d == d.to_integral_value() else de(d)
    finish = ("DRY RUN: stop on the review/signing step. Do NOT request a TAN and do not submit; call finish with what "
              "the review shows." if dry_run else
              "On the review/signing step: compare the summary with the values above, then request the TAN on the page "
              "(e.g. \"TAN anfordern\"), call fetch_tan, type the TAN into its field, and call final_submit with the ref "
              "of the binding submit button. Never click that button yourself. After final_submit, finish.")
    skipped = ", ".join(result.skipped)
    return f"""Enter and sign our bid for the tender {a['tender_reference']} on this portal.
Bidder: {task.bidder_company}, VAT id {task.bidder_vat_id}{', contact e-mail ' + mailbox if mailbox else ''}.
Instructions from the brief: {task.submission_steps or '(none)'}

Decision: {'BID — choose the main offer (Hauptangebot)' if bid else 'NO BID — choose the no-bid declaration (Verzichtserklärung)'}.
Never choose an alternative offer (Nebenangebot), even when it is preselected.
{('Positions (each may be its own step, in any order — identify it by its position number):' + chr(10) + position_table(a)) if bid else 'No positions.'}
{('Positions to omit with the form option to skip/omit a position (partial credit): ' + skipped) if bid and skipped else ''}
For each position: set the configuration fields (bore, stroke, mounting, certification, …) step by step so that the
material number can be selected, then enter quantity, net unit price, the price breakdown fields and the lead time.
Never add positions ("Position hinzufügen"). Numbers in German format exactly as given above.
Conditions: discount {discount} %, net total {de(a['total_net'])} EUR (net, never the gross amount incl. VAT).
Declarations: acknowledge the tender documents; do NOT declare our own terms and conditions (AGB).
Save every step with the forward button; going back discards later steps. If a step shows validation errors, fix them.
{finish}"""


def review_problems(review: dict, answer: dict, skipped: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Differences between what the portal recorded and our answer (empty list = safe to sign)."""
    problems = []
    if norm_id(review.get("tender_reference")) != norm_id(answer["tender_reference"]):
        problems.append(f"reference shown {review.get('tender_reference')!r}, expected {answer['tender_reference']!r}")
    offer = clean(review.get("offer_type")).lower()
    want = "main" if answer["decision"] == "bid" else "no_bid"
    if offer and offer != "unknown" and offer != want:
        problems.append(f"offer type is {offer!r}, expected {want!r}")
    total = number(review.get("total_net"))
    if total is not None and total != Decimal(str(answer["total_net"])).quantize(Decimal("0.01")):
        problems.append(f"net total shown {review.get('total_net')}, expected {de(answer['total_net'])}")
    shown = {norm_id(p.get("position")): p for p in review.get("positions") or []}
    for p in answer.get("positions") or []:
        r = shown.get(norm_id(p["position"]))
        if r is None:
            if p["position"] not in skipped:
                problems.append(f"position {p['position']} missing in the summary")
            continue
        if norm_id(r.get("material_number")) != norm_id(p["material_number"]):
            problems.append(f"position {p['position']}: material {r.get('material_number')}, expected {p['material_number']}")
        if number(r.get("quantity")) != Decimal(p["quantity"]):
            problems.append(f"position {p['position']}: quantity {r.get('quantity')}, expected {p['quantity']}")
        price = number(r.get("unit_price"))
        if price is not None and price != Decimal(str(p["unit_price"])).quantize(Decimal("0.01")):
            problems.append(f"position {p['position']}: unit price {r.get('unit_price')}, expected {de(p['unit_price'])}")
    extra = set(shown) - {norm_id(p["position"]) for p in answer.get("positions") or []} - {norm_id(s) for s in skipped}
    if extra:
        problems.append(f"extra positions in the summary: {sorted(extra)} (remove them)")
    if review.get("own_terms_declared") is True:
        problems.append("our own terms (AGB) are declared — untick that")
    return problems


class Submitter:
    def __init__(self, orch, result: Result):
        self.orch, self.result = orch, result
        self.task = orch.out.task
        self.agent: SiteAgent = orch.agents[self.task.submission_site]
        self.tan_requested_at: float | None = None
        self.submitted, self.receipt = False, None

    def mailbox(self) -> str | None:
        for rec in self.orch.bb.of("mail_list"):
            addr = clean(rec.data.get("mailbox_address"))
            if "@" in addr:
                return addr
        return None

    async def fetch_tan(self, args: dict) -> str:
        self.tan_requested_at = time.time() - 5
        mail = self.orch.agent("mail")
        if mail is None:
            return "Fehler: kein Postfach bekannt."
        since = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime(self.tan_requested_at))
        before = len(self.orch.bb.of("mail_message"))
        await mail.run(Mission("tan", f"""A signing TAN for the tender {self.task.context.tender_reference} was just requested
(at {since} UTC). Find the NEWEST TAN message for exactly this reference (new TAN messages may appear without a search;
reload the list if it is not there yet), open it and extract `mail_message`. Older TANs are invalid.""",
                               kinds=["mail_message"], max_steps=20, deadline=self.orch.run_.expires_at - 20))
        tans = [r.data for r in self.orch.bb.of("mail_message")[before:] if r.data.get("topic") == "tan"
                and norm_id(r.data.get("reference") or self.task.context.tender_reference) == norm_id(self.task.context.tender_reference)]
        tans.sort(key=lambda d: when(d.get("datetime_utc")) or when("1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"))
        tan = clean(((tans[-1].get("data") or {}).get("tan")) if tans else "")
        log("tan", found=bool(tan))
        return f"TAN: {tan}" if tan else "Keine neue TAN gefunden. Fordere sie erneut an und rufe fetch_tan noch einmal auf."

    async def final_submit(self, args: dict) -> str:
        ref = args.get("ref", "")
        page = self.agent.tools.s.page
        from ..tools.observe import observe
        o = await observe(page)
        review = await extract(self.orch.llm, "bid_review", o.text, o.url, agent="submit:review")
        problems = review_problems(review, self.result.answer, self.result.skipped)
        log("review", problems=problems)
        if problems:
            return "Nicht abgegeben — die Zusammenfassung weicht ab:\n- " + "\n- ".join(problems) + "\nKorrigiere und rufe final_submit erneut auf."
        self.agent.tools.s.arm_dialog_accept()
        out = await self.agent.tools.click(ref)
        o = await observe(page)
        res = await extract(self.orch.llm, "submission_result", o.text, o.url, agent="submit:result")
        self.submitted = bool(res.get("confirmed"))
        self.receipt = res.get("receipt")
        log("submitted", confirmed=self.submitted, receipt=self.receipt, errors=res.get("errors"))
        if self.submitted:
            return f"Abgegeben. Quittung: {self.receipt}. Rufe jetzt finish auf."
        return f"Nicht bestätigt: {res.get('errors') or out.splitlines()[0]}. Lies die Seite und korrigiere."

    async def run(self) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
        extra = {}
        if not self.orch.dry_run:
            extra = {
                "fetch_tan": (_fn("fetch_tan", "After requesting the TAN on the page: get the newest signing TAN from our mailbox.", {}),
                              self.fetch_tan),
                "final_submit": (_fn("final_submit", "Check the summary against our bid and, if it matches, click the binding "
                                     "submit button (ref) and confirm the browser dialog.",
                                     {"ref": {"type": "string"}}, ["ref"]), self.final_submit),
            }
        n = len(self.result.answer.get("positions") or [])
        mission = Mission("submit", mission_text(self.task, self.result, self.mailbox(), self.orch.dry_run),
                          kinds=["bid_review"], max_steps=30 + 12 * n, deadline=self.orch.run_.expires_at - SUBMIT_RESERVE_S,
                          extra_tools=extra)
        await self.agent.run(mission)
        return self.submitted, self.receipt


async def submit(orch, result: Result) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
    run = orch.run_
    if run.submission.get("kind") == "api":           # some runs take the answer through the API
        if run.local or orch.dry_run:
            log("answer_api", local=True)
            return False, None
        status, body = contract.submit_answer(run, result.answer)
        log("answer_api", status=status, body=body[:500])
        return status == 202, None
    return await Submitter(orch, result).run()

Decision: {'BID — choose the main offer (Hauptangebot)' if bid else 'NO BID — choose the no-bid declaration (Verzichtserklärung)'}.
Never choose an alternative offer (Nebenangebot), even when it is preselected.
{('Positions (each may be its own step, in any order — identify it by its position number):' + chr(10) + position_table(a)) if bid else 'No positions.'}
{('Positions to omit with the form option to skip/omit a position (partial credit): ' + skipped) if bid and skipped else ''}
For each position: set the configuration fields (bore, stroke, mounting, certification, …) step by step so that the
material number can be selected, then enter quantity, net unit price, the price breakdown fields and the lead time.
Never add positions ("Position hinzufügen"). Numbers in German format exactly as given above.
Conditions: discount {discount} %, net total {de(a['total_net'])} EUR (net, never the gross amount incl. VAT).
Declarations: acknowledge the tender documents; do NOT declare our own terms and conditions (AGB).
Save every step with the forward button; going back discards later steps. If a step shows validation errors, fix them.
{finish}"""


def review_problems(review: dict, answer: dict, skipped: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Differences between what the portal recorded and our answer (empty list = safe to sign)."""
    problems = []
    if norm_id(review.get("tender_reference")) != norm_id(answer["tender_reference"]):
        problems.append(f"reference shown {review.get('tender_reference')!r}, expected {answer['tender_reference']!r}")
    offer = clean(review.get("offer_type")).lower()
    want = "main" if answer["decision"] == "bid" else "no_bid"
    if offer and offer != "unknown" and offer != want:
        problems.append(f"offer type is {offer!r}, expected {want!r}")
    total = number(review.get("total_net"))
    if total is not None and total != Decimal(str(answer["total_net"])).quantize(Decimal("0.01")):
        problems.append(f"net total shown {review.get('total_net')}, expected {de(answer['total_net'])}")
    shown = {norm_id(p.get("position")): p for p in review.get("positions") or []}
    for p in answer.get("positions") or []:
        r = shown.get(norm_id(p["position"]))
        if r is None:
            if p["position"] not in skipped:
                problems.append(f"position {p['position']} missing in the summary")
            continue
        if norm_id(r.get("material_number")) != norm_id(p["material_number"]):
            problems.append(f"position {p['position']}: material {r.get('material_number')}, expected {p['material_number']}")
        if number(r.get("quantity")) != Decimal(p["quantity"]):
            problems.append(f"position {p['position']}: quantity {r.get('quantity')}, expected {p['quantity']}")
        price = number(r.get("unit_price"))
        if price is not None and price != Decimal(str(p["unit_price"])).quantize(Decimal("0.01")):
            problems.append(f"position {p['position']}: unit price {r.get('unit_price')}, expected {de(p['unit_price'])}")
    extra = set(shown) - {norm_id(p["position"]) for p in answer.get("positions") or []} - {norm_id(s) for s in skipped}
    if extra:
        problems.append(f"extra positions in the summary: {sorted(extra)} (remove them)")
    if review.get("own_terms_declared") is True:
        problems.append("our own terms (AGB) are declared — untick that")
    return problems


class Submitter:
    def __init__(self, orch, result: Result):
        self.orch, self.result = orch, result
        self.task = orch.out.task
        self.agent: SiteAgent = orch.agents[self.task.submission_site]
        self.tan_requested_at: float | None = None
        self.submitted, self.receipt = False, None

    def mailbox(self) -> str | None:
        for rec in self.orch.bb.of("mail_list"):
            addr = clean(rec.data.get("mailbox_address"))
            if "@" in addr:
                return addr
        return None

    async def fetch_tan(self, args: dict) -> str:
        self.tan_requested_at = time.time() - 5
        mail = self.orch.agent("mail")
        if mail is None:
            return "Fehler: kein Postfach bekannt."
        since = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime(self.tan_requested_at))
        before = len(self.orch.bb.of("mail_message"))
        await mail.run(Mission("tan", f"""A signing TAN for the tender {self.task.context.tender_reference} was just requested
(at {since} UTC). Find the NEWEST TAN message for exactly this reference (new TAN messages may appear without a search;
reload the list if it is not there yet), open it and extract `mail_message`. Older TANs are invalid.""",
                               kinds=["mail_message"], max_steps=20, deadline=self.orch.run_.expires_at - 20))
        tans = [r.data for r in self.orch.bb.of("mail_message")[before:] if r.data.get("topic") == "tan"
                and norm_id(r.data.get("reference") or self.task.context.tender_reference) == norm_id(self.task.context.tender_reference)]
        tans.sort(key=lambda d: when(d.get("datetime_utc")) or when("1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"))
        tan = clean(((tans[-1].get("data") or {}).get("tan")) if tans else "")
        log("tan", found=bool(tan))
        return f"TAN: {tan}" if tan else "Keine neue TAN gefunden. Fordere sie erneut an und rufe fetch_tan noch einmal auf."

    async def final_submit(self, args: dict) -> str:
        ref = args.get("ref", "")
        page = self.agent.tools.s.page
        from ..tools.observe import observe
        o = await observe(page)
        review = await extract(self.orch.llm, "bid_review", o.text, o.url, agent="submit:review")
        problems = review_problems(review, self.result.answer, self.result.skipped)
        log("review", problems=problems)
        if problems:
            return "Nicht abgegeben — die Zusammenfassung weicht ab:\n- " + "\n- ".join(problems) + "\nKorrigiere und rufe final_submit erneut auf."
        self.agent.tools.s.arm_dialog_accept()
        out = await self.agent.tools.click(ref)
        o = await observe(page)
        res = await extract(self.orch.llm, "submission_result", o.text, o.url, agent="submit:result")
        self.submitted = bool(res.get("confirmed"))
        self.receipt = res.get("receipt")
        log("submitted", confirmed=self.submitted, receipt=self.receipt, errors=res.get("errors"))
        if self.submitted:
            return f"Abgegeben. Quittung: {self.receipt}. Rufe jetzt finish auf."
        return f"Nicht bestätigt: {res.get('errors') or out.splitlines()[0]}. Lies die Seite und korrigiere."

    async def run(self) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
        extra = {}
        if not self.orch.dry_run:
            extra = {
                "fetch_tan": (_fn("fetch_tan", "After requesting the TAN on the page: get the newest signing TAN from our mailbox.", {}),
                              self.fetch_tan),
                "final_submit": (_fn("final_submit", "Check the summary against our bid and, if it matches, click the binding "
                                     "submit button (ref) and confirm the browser dialog.",
                                     {"ref": {"type": "string"}}, ["ref"]), self.final_submit),
            }
        n = len(self.result.answer.get("positions") or [])
        mission = Mission("submit", mission_text(self.task, self.result, self.mailbox(), self.orch.dry_run),
                          kinds=["bid_review"], max_steps=30 + 12 * n, deadline=self.orch.run_.expires_at - SUBMIT_RESERVE_S,
                          extra_tools=extra)
        await self.agent.run(mission)
        return self.submitted, self.receipt


async def submit(orch, result: Result) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
    run = orch.run_
    if run.submission.get("kind") == "api":           # some runs take the answer through the API
        if run.local or orch.dry_run:
            log("answer_api", local=True)
            return False, None
        status, body = contract.submit_answer(run, result.answer)
        log("answer_api", status=status, body=body[:500])
        return status == 202, None
    return await Submitter(orch, result).run()

entries.name: Monitor
entries.description:
Start a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. Each stdout line is an event — you keep working and notifications arrive in the chat. Events arrive on their own schedule and are not replies from the user, even if one lands while you're waiting for the user to answer a question.

Pick by how many notifications you need:
- **One** ("tell me when the server is ready / the build finishes") → use **Bash with `run_in_background`** and a command that exits when the condition is true, e.g. `until grep -q "Ready in" dev.log; do sleep 0.5; done`. You get a single completion notification when it exits.
- **One per occurrence, until the monitor expires (re-arm to continue)** ("tell me every time an ERROR line appears") → Monitor with an unbounded command (`tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, `while true`).
- **One per occurrence, until a known end** ("emit each CI step result, stop when the run completes") → Monitor with a command that emits lines and then exits.

Your script's stdout is the event stream. Each line becomes a notification. Exit ends the watch.

  # Each matching log line is an event
  tail -f /var/log/app.log | grep --line-buffered "ERROR"

  # Each file change is an event
  inotifywait -m --format '%e %f' /watched/dir

  # Poll GitHub for new PR comments and emit one line per new comment
  last=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  while true; do
    now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
    gh api "repos/owner/repo/issues/123/comments?since=$last" --jq '.[] | "\(.user.login): \(.body)"'
    last=$now; sleep 30
  done

  # Node script that emits events as they arrive (e.g. WebSocket listener)
  node watch-for-events.js

  # Per-occurrence with a natural end: emit each CI check as it lands, exit when the run completes
  prev=""
  while true; do
    s=$(gh pr checks 123 --json name,bucket)
    cur=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.bucket!="pending") | "\(.name): \(.bucket)"' <<<"$s" | sort)
    comm -13 <(echo "$prev") <(echo "$cur")
    prev=$cur
    jq -e 'all(.bucket!="pending")' <<<"$s" >/dev/null && break
    sleep 30
  done

**Don't use an unbounded command for a single notification.** `tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, and `while true` never exit on their own, so the monitor stays armed until timeout even after the event has fired. For "tell me when X is ready," use Bash `run_in_background` with an `until` loop instead (one notification, ends in seconds). Note that `tail -f log | grep -m 1 ...` does *not* fix this: if the log goes quiet after the match, `tail` never receives SIGPIPE and the pipeline hangs anyway.

**Script quality:**
- Every pipe stage must flush per line or matches sit in its buffer unseen: `grep` needs `--line-buffered`, `awk` needs `fflush()`. `head` cannot flush at all — `| head -N` delivers nothing until N matches accumulate, then ends the stream.
- In poll loops, handle transient failures (`curl ... || true`) — one failed request shouldn't kill the monitor.
- Poll intervals: 30s+ for remote APIs (rate limits), 0.5-1s for local checks.
- Write a specific `description` — it appears in every notification ("errors in deploy.log" not "watching logs").
- Only stdout is the event stream. Stderr goes to the output file (readable via Read) but does not trigger notifications — for a command you run directly (e.g. `python train.py 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered ...`), merge stderr with `2>&1` so its failures reach your filter. (No effect on `tail -f` of an existing log — that file only contains what its writer redirected.)

**Coverage — silence is not success.** When watching a job or process for an outcome, your filter must match every terminal state, not just the happy path. A monitor that greps only for the success marker stays silent through a crashloop, a hung process, or an unexpected exit — and silence looks identical to "still running." Before arming, ask: *if this process crashed right now, would my filter emit anything?* If not, widen it.

  # Wrong — silent on crash, hang, or any non-success exit
  tail -f run.log | grep --line-buffered "elapsed_steps="

  # Right — one alternation covering progress + the failure signatures you'd act on
  tail -f run.log | grep -E --line-buffered "elapsed_steps=|Traceback|Error|FAILED|assert|Killed|OOM"

For poll loops checking job state, emit on every terminal status (`succeeded|failed|cancelled|timeout`), not just success. If you cannot confidently enumerate the failure signatures, broaden the grep alternation rather than narrow it — some extra noise is better than missing a crashloop.

**Output volume**: Every stdout line is a conversation message, so the filter should be selective — but selective means "the lines you'd act on," not "only good news." Never pipe raw logs; filter to exactly the success and failure signals you care about. Monitors that produce too many events are automatically stopped; restart with a tighter filter if this happens.

Stdout lines within 200ms are batched into a single notification, so multiline output from a single event groups naturally.

The script runs in the same shell environment as Bash. Exit ends the watch (exit code is reported). Every monitor expires after `timeout_ms` (default 5 minutes, at most 30 minutes): it is killed and you get one notice with the event count. Re-arm it if you still need the watch; for a long watch (PR monitoring, log tails) set `timeout_ms` to the maximum and re-arm on each expiry, and widen the filter if an expiry with no events was unexpected. Use TaskStop to cancel early.
**ws source** — open a WebSocket and stream each incoming text frame as an event. No shell, no polling: the server pushes, you get notified.

  Monitor({
    ws: {url: 'wss://events.example.com/stream', protocols: ['v1']},
    description: 'deploy events',
  })

Each text frame becomes one notification (multiline frames stay as one event). Binary frames are reported as `[binary frame, N bytes]` rather than passed through. Socket close ends the watch with the close code surfaced; errors are surfaced before close. Same rate limiting as bash — a firehose will be suppressed and eventually stopped, so subscribe to a filtered feed where one exists.

Prefer this over `command: 'websocat wss://…'` — it avoids the extra process and line-buffering pitfalls. Use bash when you need to transform or filter frames with shell tools before they become events.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring (shown in notifications).

timeout_ms.description: Kill the monitor after this deadline. Default 300000ms. Deadlines above 1800000ms are capped to 1800000ms. You are notified at expiry and can re-arm.

command.description: Shell command or script. Each stdout line is an event; exit ends the watch.

ws.description: WebSocket to open. Each text frame is an event; binary frames are reported as a placeholder line. Socket close ends the watch. Cannot be combined with command.

"""Orchestrator helpers on a synthetic blackboard: current revision, catalogue groups, gap check. Values are made up."""
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from rfq.agent.blackboard import Blackboard
from rfq.agent.brief import Task
from rfq.agent.orchestrator import Orchestrator, catalogue_groups, current_requirements, requirement_lines
from rfq.contract import Run
from rfq.rules.resolve import Context


def board(*records):
    bb = Blackboard()
    for kind, data in records:
        asyncio.run(bb.add(kind, data, "s", "u"))
    return bb


REVS = ("spec_revisions", {"revisions": [{"revision": "R-1", "is_current": False}, {"revision": "R-2", "is_current": True}]})
OLD = ("requirements", {"revision": "R-1", "requirements": [{"ref": "A-1", "catalog_group": "G-OLD", "bore_mm": "40"}]})
NEW = ("requirements", {"revision": "R-2", "requirements": [{"ref": "A-1", "catalog_group": "G-1", "bore_mm": "50"},
                                                            {"ref": "A-2", "catalog_group": "G-2", "usable_stroke": True}]})


def test_only_the_current_revision_counts():
    bb = board(REVS, OLD, NEW)
    assert [r["catalog_group"] for r in current_requirements(bb)] == ["G-1", "G-2"]
    assert catalogue_groups(bb) == ["G-1", "G-2"]
    assert "A-1: bore_mm=50, catalog_group=G-1" in requirement_lines(bb)


def test_unknown_current_revision_keeps_all_rows():
    assert len(current_requirements(board(OLD, NEW))) == 3


def orch_with(bb):
    run = Run(brief="", access=[], submission={}, answer_schema={}, expires_at=0)
    o = Orchestrator(run, llm=None, sites={})
    o.bb = bb
    o.out.task = Task(Context("XT-1", datetime(2030, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)), roles={"erp": "erp"})
    o.agents = {"erp": object()}
    return o


def test_gaps_name_what_is_missing():
    bb = board(REVS, NEW, ("positions", {"positions": [{"position": "1", "requirement_ref": "A-3"}]}),
               ("materials", {"materials": [{"material_number": "M1", "catalog_group": "G-1"}]}))
    gaps = {role: what for role, what, _ in orch_with(bb).gaps()}
    assert "clarifications" in gaps["tender"]                 # positions there, Q&A not
    assert "A-3" in gaps["specification"]                     # a position needs a requirement we lack
    assert "G-2" in gaps["erp"] and "G-1" not in gaps["erp"].split("for these")[0]
    assert "mail" in gaps


def test_no_gaps_when_complete():
    bb = board(REVS, NEW, ("positions", {"positions": [{"position": "1", "requirement_ref": "A-1"}]}),
               ("clarifications", {"entries": []}), ("mail_message", {"subject": "x"}),
               ("materials", {"materials": [{"catalog_group": "G-1"}, {"catalog_group": "G-2"}]}))
    assert orch_with(bb).gaps() == []

from rfq.agent.orchestrator import Orchestrator, catalogue_groups, current_requirements, requirement_lines
from rfq.contract import Run
from rfq.rules.resolve import Context


def board(*records):
    bb = Blackboard()
    for kind, data in records:
        asyncio.run(bb.add(kind, data, "s", "u"))
    return bb


REVS = ("spec_revisions", {"revisions": [{"revision": "R-1", "is_current": False}, {"revision": "R-2", "is_current": True}]})
OLD = ("requirements", {"revision": "R-1", "requirements": [{"ref": "A-1", "catalog_group": "G-OLD", "bore_mm": "40"}]})
NEW = ("requirements", {"revision": "R-2", "requirements": [{"ref": "A-1", "catalog_group": "G-1", "bore_mm": "50"},
                                                            {"ref": "A-2", "catalog_group": "G-2", "usable_stroke": True}]})


def test_only_the_current_revision_counts():
    bb = board(REVS, OLD, NEW)
    assert [r["catalog_group"] for r in current_requirements(bb)] == ["G-1", "G-2"]
    assert catalogue_groups(bb) == ["G-1", "G-2"]
    assert "A-1: bore_mm=50, catalog_group=G-1" in requirement_lines(bb)


def test_unknown_current_revision_keeps_all_rows():
    assert len(current_requirements(board(OLD, NEW))) == 3


def orch_with(bb):
    run = Run(brief="", access=[], submission={}, answer_schema={}, expires_at=0)
    o = Orchestrator(run, llm=None, sites={})
    o.bb = bb
    o.out.task = Task(Context("XT-1", datetime(2030, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)), roles={"erp": "erp"})
    o.agents = {"erp": object()}
    return o


def test_gaps_name_what_is_missing():
    bb = board(REVS, NEW, ("positions", {"positions": [{"position": "1", "requirement_ref": "A-3"}]}),
               ("materials", {"materials": [{"material_number": "M1", "catalog_group": "G-1"}]}))
    gaps = {role: what for role, what, _ in orch_with(bb).gaps()}
    assert "clarifications" in gaps["tender"]                 # positions there, Q&A not
    assert "A-3" in gaps["specification"]                     # a position needs a requirement we lack
    assert "G-2" in gaps["erp"] and "G-1" not in gaps["erp"].split("for these")[0]
    assert "mail" in gaps


def test_no_gaps_when_complete():
    bb = board(REVS, NEW, ("positions", {"positions": [{"position": "1", "requirement_ref": "A-1"}]}),
               ("clarifications", {"entries": []}), ("mail_message", {"subject": "x"}),
               ("materials", {"materials": [{"catalog_group": "G-1"}, {"catalog_group": "G-2"}]}))
    assert orch_with(bb).gaps() == []

async def _run_retry(self, role: str, mission) -> MissionResult | None:
        """A mission that ends without storing all its kinds gets one immediate retry (others keep working)."""
        res = await self._run(role, mission)
        lacking = [k for k in mission.kinds if not self.bb.of(k)]
        if res is None or not lacking or self.evidence_deadline - time.time() < FOLLOW_UP_MIN_S:
            return res
        log("retry", role=role, mission=mission.name, reason=res.reason, lacking=lacking)
        why = f"The previous attempt ended with '{res.reason}'" + (f" ({res.summary[:200]})" if res.summary else "")
        retry = missions.follow_up(self.out.task, self.evidence_deadline,
                                   f"{why}. Still needed: {', '.join(lacking)}.\nOriginal mission:\n{mission.goal}", lacking)
        retry.max_steps = mission.max_steps
        return await self._run(role, retry)

#!/bin/sh
# Scouting env without `atira scout --env` and without `atira models proxy` (dev only).
# Use when the CLI's proxy hangs ("HTTP/2: headers timeout"): models are called on the platform's proxy directly,
# with the personal token in the path (docs/run-contract.md#llm-calls, "Development outside runs").
# usage: eval "$(sh dev/scout/direct_env.sh)"     — nothing is written to disk; the agent's log masks the token
set -e
API=${ATIRA_API:-https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai}
TOKEN=$(atira token)
SCOUTING=$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 -A isar-labs-dev "$API/v1/challenges/rfq/scouting")
ACCESS=$(printf '%s' "$SCOUTING" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(json.load(sys.stdin)["access"]))')
q() { printf "'%s'" "$(printf '%s' "$1" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g")"; }
echo "export CHALLENGE_SCOUTING=$(q "$SCOUTING")"
echo "export CHALLENGE_SITE_ACCESS=$(q "$ACCESS")"
echo "export QWEN_BASE_URL=$(q "$API/llm/team/$TOKEN/qwen/v1")"
echo "export QWEN_API_KEY=$(q "$TOKEN")"
echo "export CLEF_BASE_URL=$(q "$API/llm/team/$TOKEN/clef")"
echo "export CLEF_API_KEY=$(q "$TOKEN")"

from main. The submit agent fills the bid form from the answer and checks

input.command:
cd /Users/korbi/Documents/coding/isar-labs-ehl/agent && python3 - <<'PY'
p = "rfq/agent/orchestrator.py"
s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
old_start = s.index("    async def team(self, role: str, n: int) -> list[SiteAgent]:")
old_end = s.index("    @staticmethod\n    def share(")
new = '''    async def team(self, role: str, n: int) -> list[SiteAgent]:
        """The role's agent plus up to n-1 more on new browser contexts of the same website (parallel work). Extra
        sessions open in parallel; one that is not ready within SPAWN_TIMEOUT_S is left out."""
        first = self.agent(role)
        if first is None:
            return []
        sid = self.out.task.site(role)

        async def extra(i: int) -> SiteAgent | None:
            try:
                tools = await asyncio.wait_for(self.spawn(sid), SPAWN_TIMEOUT_S)
                return SiteAgent(tools, self.llm, self.bb, name=f"{sid}#{i}")
            except Exception as e:
                log("warning", msg=f"extra session {sid}#{i} left out: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
                return None
        more = await asyncio.gather(*(extra(i) for i in range(2, n + 1))) if self.spawn and n > 1 else []
        agents = [first] + [a for a in more if a]
        log("team", role=role, wanted=n, size=len(agents))
        return agents

'''
s = s[:old_start] + new + s[old_end:]
s = s.replace('''ERP_GROUPS_PER_AGENT = 2''', '''ERP_GROUPS_PER_AGENT = 2
SPAWN_TIMEOUT_S = 45              # an extra session that is not logged in by then is left out''')
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
